name: Liquid redox sulfur recovery (LO-CAT)
principle: Hydrogen sulfide is absorbed into an aqueous solution of an iron chelate catalyst, where it is oxidised to elemental sulfur (H2S + 1/2 O2 -> S + H2O). The reduced catalyst is regenerated by air in an oxidiser, and the sulfur is separated as a slurry or cake. The process suits small to mid-size H2S loads and streams that are too lean or too dilute for a Claus plant.
